data.gender_notes: Nitya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'nitya' meaning perpetual, constant and eternal. It is a name for a baby girl born into the Hindu community. The name Nitya carries the meaning “Day, Time” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Nitya usually hope their child will grow to embody day, time and live with faith, good character and purpose.
